title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-13 05:29:19 最新章节：第二百二十六章 妈妈回来啦
slug: 新婚夜反杀家暴男极品全家求我别疯
content_zh:
“天天躺炕上装死，啥活不干还得让我这个婆婆伺候你，你是祖宗啊！我家德发娶了你真是倒了八辈子血霉，又晦气又恶心！”
“就是，嫂子不像嫂子，媳妇不像媳妇，每天不洗衣做饭也就算了，还让妈给你端屎端尿，你算什么东西？”
何浅浅听着婆婆和小姑子的谩骂，一颗心比身底的炕还凉。
她19岁嫁给张德发，替他照顾两个他跟前任生的孩子，伺候小姑子，任劳任怨，从没跟公婆顶过一句嘴。
因为自己不能生娃被他们百般嫌弃万般磋磨。
那是她不想生吗？
是她刚嫁过来时被张德发打坏了身子落下病了！
半月前，张德发耍酒疯又打断了她一条腿，冰天雪地，她被扔在外面冻了一夜。
天亮后抬进来人已经不行了，张家上下没一个带她看病买药的。
何浅浅闭了闭眼，虚弱地开口，“妈，我想回家一趟。”
她想回娘家养病。
张老太太剜了她一眼，“赶紧回去，天天吃白饭不干活，养你有啥用？也别等德发了，红艳，你骑三轮送你大嫂一趟，把这个灾星轰出去家里也能清静清静，埋汰死了。”
小姑子巴不得把她撵走呢，三下五除二就把何浅浅弄到三轮车上。
老何家。
“嫁出去的闺女泼出去的水，没听说过门的媳妇还有往回送的。浅浅，不是当奶奶的说你，你才30岁，整天病病殃殃的像什么话，你这样哪个男人不膈应你？”
何老太太满嘴喷唾沫星子，抬头看向张红艳，“红艳，你受累把你大嫂抬回去吧，我们家啥条件你也知道，哪有钱给她看病啊。”
张红艳已经走到门口了，“大娘，你这叫什么话，何浅浅是你亲孙女，她病病歪歪的你不管谁管？”
好不容易甩掉的祸害，再抬回去妈不得骂死她。
一旁的何金贵开口了，“我管得过来吗，老话讲嫁鸡随鸡嫁狗随狗，我把闺女嫁到你们家了，她是死是活都是你们老张家的，这眼看着快断气了送到我家算怎么回事？”
“你们自己看着办呗！”张红艳撂下这句，扭头就走。

“天杀的烂货，你给我回来！”何老太太拄着拐棍气哼哼地撵出去。
没追上便回来使劲拧何浅浅两把，“丧门星！我要是你男人一天打你八百遍都不解气，你早早给德发生个胖小子，他能把你往出推？干啥啥不行的货，死了阎王都不收你。”
何浅浅心里憋屈，自己怎么病成这样的，他们问都不问。
张德发两天不打她，三天早早的，这些年她每次回娘家求助，他们都说谁家爷们不打媳妇啊，感情都是打出来的。
要不就拿她生不出孩子要挟她，称也就德发不嫌弃她，换成别的男人早一脚把她踹了。
她最多在娘家待半天。
要么被张德发接回去，要么被娘家人赶出来。
“爸，奶，我这病吃点药就好了，你们帮我抓点药吧，求求你们了。”何浅浅哭着哀求，“等我病好就跟张德发离婚，回来好好孝敬你们。”
谁知老太太听都没听，直接招呼儿子，“金贵，你去单位把德发找来，让她把媳妇接回去，家里人口这么多吃饱饭都费劲，哪有钱给她抓药，就算病好了也是个瘸子，啥啥也干不了。”
“嗯！”何金贵点点头出去了。
content_en:
"You lie on the kang every day and pretend to be dead. You have to let me, my mother-in-law, take care of you when you don't have to do any work. You are an ancestor! My Defa married you for eight lifetimes, which is really bad luck. It's unlucky and disgusting!"
"It's just that a sister-in-law is not like a sister-in-law, and a daughter-in-law is not like a daughter-in-law. It doesn't matter if she doesn't do laundry and cook every day. What kind of person do you think you are if you ask your mother to carry your feces and urine for you?"
He Qianqian listened to the abuse from her mother-in-law and sister-in-law, and her heart felt colder than the kang under her body.
She married Zhang Defa at the age of 19, took care of his two children from his previous relationship, served his sister-in-law, worked hard and never complained, and never said anything back to her parents-in-law.
Because she couldn't have a baby, she was disliked and tortured by them in every possible way.
Does that mean she doesn't want to have a baby?
It was because she was beaten badly by Zhang Defa when she first got married and fell ill!
Half a month ago, Zhang Defa was drunk and broke one of her legs. She was left outside to freeze in the ice and snow all night.
It was no longer possible to bring her in after dawn, and no one in the Zhang family could take her to see a doctor or buy medicine.
He Qianqian closed her eyes and said weakly, "Mom, I want to go home."
She wanted to return to her parents' home to recuperate.
Old Mrs. Zhang gave her a look and said, "Go back quickly. If you don't work every day, what's the use of raising you? Don't wait for Defa, Hongyan. You can ride a tricycle to see your sister-in-law. After driving this disaster star out, the house can be quiet and peaceful. Mi Tai is dead."
The sister-in-law was eager to drive her away, so she got He Qianqian onto the tricycle.
Lao He's family.
"When a married daughter throws water away, I've never heard of an unmarried daughter-in-law sending it back. Qianqian, I'm not a grandma talking about you. You are only 30 years old and you are so sick all day long. What man wouldn't hate you?"
Old Mrs. He spat with saliva and looked up at Zhang Hongyan, "Hongyan, if you are tired, please take your sister-in-law back. You know the conditions of our family, how can you afford her medical treatment?"
Zhang Hongyan has already walked to the door, "Auntie, what are you talking about? He Qianqian is your granddaughter. Who do you care about her illness?"
After finally getting rid of the scourge, my mother would not scold her to death if I brought her back.
He Jingui on the side spoke, "Can I take care of it? As the old saying goes, if you marry a chicken, follow the chicken, marry a dog, follow the dog. I married my daughter to your family, and whether she is dead or alive, she belongs to your old Zhang family. What's going on when she is sent to my house now that she is about to die?"
"You can figure it out yourself!" Zhang Hongyan said this and turned around to leave.
"You damn bastard, come back here!" Mrs. He angrily drove her out with a cane.
Before he could catch up, he came back and pinched He Qianqian hard, "Sangmen Xing! If I were your man and couldn't get rid of my anger even if I beat you eight hundred times a day, why don't you give birth to a fat boy early on, and he can push you out? Even if you are dead, the king of hell won't accept you."
He Qianqian felt aggrieved. They didn't even ask how she became so ill.
Zhang Defa didn't hit her for two days, and three days earlier. Every time she went back to her parents' home for help in the past few years, they all said that any man didn't hit his wife, because the feelings were all played out.
Otherwise, he would threaten her with the idea that she could not give birth to a child, saying that Defa would not despise her, and if it had been another man, he would have kicked her.
She can stay at her parents' house for at most half a day.
Either he would be taken back by Zhang Defa, or he would be kicked out by his family.
"Dad, Mom, my illness will be cured if I take some medicine. Please help me get some medicine, please." He Qianqian cried and begged, "When I recover, I will divorce Zhang Defa and come back to honor you."
Unexpectedly, the old lady didn't even listen, and directly called her son, "Jin Gui, go to the work and find De Fa and ask her to take her daughter-in-law back. With such a large family, it's hard for her to have enough to eat. How can she have the money to get her medicine? Even if she recovers, she will still be a cripple and can't do anything."
"Yeah!" He Jingui nodded and went out.
